symptom: a page whose `image` widget names `ModA.Icons.pix` was refused by check ("image collection not found: ModA.Icons (referenced as ModA.Icons.pix)") and by exec ("Refusing to execute: 1 unresolved reference(s) above. Nothing was written.") when the same script created the collection; split into two scripts it passed (mendixlabs/mxcli#1419)
cause: validateWidgetReferences resolved image refs against the project only, under a comment saying MDL cannot create an image collection — stale since CreateImageCollectionStmt existed; scriptContext had no image-collection or image sets
insight: **A comment justifying a missing same-script exemption ages into the bug.** Every other widget reference kind merges `sc.<kind>` into the project set; grep `validateWidgetReferences` for a kind that does not, and check whether the statement that creates it now exists. Merge only into non-nil project sets: nil means the project could not be read and must keep reporting nothing. The pre-check context is whole-script (collectDefinitions), like the other kinds — statement-order is not enforced here
